schema.title: ResponseEnvelope_for_ChatThreadsListDto
schema.description:
The response envelope every transport wraps a payload in (ADR 0012).

A success carries `data`; a failure carries `error`. Both are optional on the wire so a payload from a newer server (extra fields, both absent) still parses for an older client.

api_version.description: The API version the server answered under.

schema_version.description: The wire schema version the payload was written against.

post.summary: Evaluate strategy loop pipeline, stop-hunt comparison, expiry hedge, and 6-layer OverlayScene

schema.title: StrategyLoopRequest
schema.description: Request for `POST /api/v2/studies/strategy-loop/evaluate`.

capital.description: Optional allocated strategy capital in INR for equity risk % sizing (default `500000`).

expiry_horizon.description: Target expiry horizon for derivative hedge synthesis.

futures_roll_basis_bps.description: Optional futures rollover basis in basis points (`-500..=500`, default `0`).

horizon_bars.description: Holding horizon in bars after signal entry (default `5` daily / `12` intraday).

include_statutory_costs.description: Deduct Indian statutory costs (STT, stamp, SEBI, GST). Defaults to `true`.

lot_size.description: Optional lot size override (defaults to instrument master lot size or `50`).

max_chart_bars.description: Optional cap on returned chart bars (default `300`, clamped `20..=1500`); KPIs still use full date range.

session_id.description: Optional interactive session ID to track iterative refinement runs.

sl_buffer_atr.description: Outer stop-loss ATR buffer multiplier (`0.00..=3.00`, default `0.25`).

spread_slippage_bps.description: Optional bid-ask slippage in basis points (`0..=500`, default `2`).

target_r.description: Primary reward target R multiple (`>= 1`, default `3`).

tick_size.description: Optional tick size override (defaults to instrument master tick size or `0.05`).

200.description: Strategy loop evaluation report and 6-layer OverlayScene

post.summary: Synthesize expiry-aware F&O/commodity hedge structures from live option chain and outer-buffer tails

schema.title: ExpiryHedgeRequest
schema.description: Request for `POST /api/v2/studies/strategy-loop/recommend-hedge`.

direction.description: Optional explicit directional bias (`None` uses latest strategy signal or neutral `ZoneIronCondor`).

end_date.description: Optional historical lookback end date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, defaults to today UTC).

horizon_bars.description: Optional evaluation holding horizon in bars for penetration percentiles (default `5`).

include_statutory_costs.description: Include Indian statutory costs (STT, GST, SEBI). Defaults to `true`.

iv_gt_rv.description: Set true when implied volatility exceeds realized volatility (`IV > RV`).

sl_buffer_atr.description: Optional outer stop-loss buffer multiplier in ATR (default `0.25`).

start_date.description: Optional historical lookback start date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, defaults to 180 days before `end_date`).

strategy_id.description: Optional strategy ID to anchor S1/S2/R1/R2 zones & penetration stats (defaults to `"elephant_edge_v3"`).

RiskLimits.title: RiskLimits
RiskLimits.description:
Hard risk limits applied synchronously to all outgoing orders and decisions.

This struct merges rules from `tantra-ledger::RiskLimits` (deprecated) with the canonical tantra-risk risk limit schema.

Legacy fields from `tantra-ledger` (mapped during Phase 1.2): - `max_notional` (f64, per-order notional ceiling) → `max_notional_per_order` (Decimal) - `max_participation` (f64, fraction of ADV) → `max_quantity_per_order` (Quantity) - `order_rate` (OrderRateLimit) → `order_rate_limit` (OrderRateLimit) - `stale_after_ms` (u64, feed staleness) → tracked via separate circuit breaker

New tantra-risk fields: - `max_daily_loss` (Decimal, daily cumulative loss limit) - `price_collar_bps` (u32, market order deviation collar in basis points)

freeze_limits.description: Per-scrip freeze limits (exchange single-order quantity ceilings). Maps instrument to maximum allowed quantity per single order. Examples: NIFTY → 1,800, BANKNIFTY → 900.

max_daily_loss.description: Maximum allowable daily cumulative loss (in INR).

max_mis_leverage.description: Maximum gross leverage for intraday (MIS) products. E.g., 5.0 means max 5x leverage on gross exposure vs equity.

max_notional_per_order.description: Maximum notional value (in INR) permitted per single order. `None` = no notional rule; `Some` must be finite and `> 0`.

max_position_concentration_pct.description: Maximum single-scrip position concentration as a percentage of total portfolio equity (e.g., 10.0 means max 10% in any one scrip).

max_quantity_per_order.description: Maximum quantity permitted per single order.

order_rate_limit.description: Global order rate limit across the platform.

price_collar_bps.description: Allowed market order deviation collar in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

The trade read model (`GET /trades` and the journal fill records): one realized execution.

This is the transport-owned wire view of [`tantra_core::FillReport`], kept a distinct type so the wire shape is this surface's contract, not the kernel's: the traded instrument is named `instrument_id` (matching every other wire record on this surface) while the kernel field stays `instrument`.
